aspect: HONEST GAP - the absenteeism and output research does not exist
description: Searches of this literature surface somatic prevalence, chronic pain and occupational stress, but little quantifying workplace productivity loss or absenteeism in this population. It is an under-studied dimension, and this row says so rather than inventing a figure.
energy_note: The mechanism is documented. The number is not.

aspect: What can be said from the components
description: Somatic symptom disorder at 32.5% with back pain in half of those, chronic pain with 83-89% distress rates, degraded sleep, and 20-200 days a year of administrative load. Each has a known effect on output; nobody has multiplied them together for this population.
energy_note: Four large effects, never added up.

aspect: Why the study is not done is itself part of the dataset
description: Research requires funding, access, institutional stability and researchers willing to take the professional risk. EDU-001, PSY-003 and DIA-001 each remove one of those.
energy_note: The evidence gap has the same causes as the harm.
